url.description: One Mercado Livre Brazil product page URL, one per call: a listing link (produto.mercadolivre.com.br/MLB-…), a catalog link (www.mercadolivre.com.br/…/p/MLB…) or a product link (…/up/MLBU…). Opened unchanged.
url.title: maxLength(2000)

Trimmed.description: a string with no leading or trailing whitespace
Trimmed.title: trimmed

item_id.description: The listing (item) id of the offer the page shows, such as MLB1234567890

catalog_product_id.description: The catalog product id (the /p/MLB… page) the offer belongs to, or null when the listing is not part of a catalog product

user_product_id.description: The site's user-product id (MLBU…) for the offer, or null when the page has none

title.description: The product title as the page's heading shows it
title.title: nonEmptyString

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of every amount, as the page states it

price.description: Current price in BRL as a number. When the page shows a Pix price as its main price and a separate regular price ("ou R$ X em …"), this is that regular price; otherwise it is the main price shown
price.title: nonNegative

previous_price.description: The crossed-out previous price in BRL, or null when the page shows none

discount_percent.description: The discount percent the page shows beside the price ("35% OFF" is 35), or null when it shows none

pix_price.description: The price in BRL for paying with Pix when the page labels its main price "no Pix", or null when the page shows no Pix price

installments_text.description: The installments line under the price as the page shows it, such as "6x R$ 54,98 sem juros", or null when the page shows none

condition.description: The item's condition from the page's data: new, used, refurbished or not_specified

condition_label.description: The condition as the page's subtitle words it, such as "Novo" or "Usado", or null when the subtitle shows none

sold_text.description: The sales count text from the page's subtitle, such as "+5 mil vendidos", or null when it shows none

seller_name.description: The seller's name (the official store's name for an official store)
seller_name.title: nonEmptyString

official_store.description: Whether the seller is an official store (Loja oficial)

free_shipping.description: Whether the listing itself ships free, from the page's data; a one-off first-purchase free delivery promotion does not count

stock_text.description: The stock or availability text the page shows, such as "Estoque disponível" or "Último disponível!"
stock_text.title: nonEmptyString

available_quantity_text.description: The available quantity note beside the quantity picker, such as "(+50 disponíveis)", or null when the page shows none

rating.description: Average rating out of 5 shown in the header, or null when the product has no reviews

review_count.description: Number of reviews (opinions) shown beside the rating, not a sales count, or null when the product has no reviews

image_url.description: URL of the main product image, as the gallery's first image shows it
image_url.title: nonEmptyString

canonical_url.description: The page's canonical URL as it declares it
canonical_url.title: nonEmptyString

page_url.description: The URL the product page finally landed on after the site's redirects
page_url.title: nonEmptyString
